name: self-learning-mail-triage
description: An Outlook mail triage plugin that learns from reviewed reply edits and resolved conversations.

interface.shortDescription: Clean your inbox. Draft in your voice. Learn from your edits.
interface.longDescription: Keeps attention-worthy mail unread, prepares unsent replies, and improves a local preference playbook using matched draft outcomes and redacted historical cases.
defaultPrompt: Review my unread inbox and show me a triage plan.
Draft replies using my preferences and similar resolved cases.
Review my reply edits and propose improvements to the playbook.
